# Find the first occurrence of 'Invoice No.' in column A
invoice_row = None
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_col=1, max_col=1):

        if cell.value == 'Invoice No.':
            invoice_row = cell.row

    if invoice_row:

    ws.delete_rows(1, invoice_row - 1)
